lines.speaker: Bunny
lines.text: Good food and a warm fire. I like it here.

lines.speaker: Fiona
lines.text: But why did the old stag call us here?

lines.speaker: Bunny
lines.text: Then we can bring some food!

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.text: He asked every animal to come. Maybe he needs help.

lines.speaker: Fiona
lines.text: Do you think something is wrong?

lines.speaker: Benji
lines.text: Let’s eat. We’ll soon find out.
